sentences.text: Issue notice to the respondent-State, returnable on  22.09.2022.
Learned APP waives service of notice for the State.
2. The applicant has been booked for the offence punishable  under Section 328, 273, 188 of the Indian Penal Code r/w Section 59  of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
It has been alleged  against the applicant that he was selling the Gutka and Pan Masala  unauthorizedly though it was prohibited in the State of Maharashtra.
The police have seized the Gutka worth Rs. 1024/-.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that Section 328 of the Indian Penal Code would not attract.

The issue is  seized with the Hon'ble Supreme Court and the Hon'ble Supreme Ganesh Bhivsen Zende vs The State Of Maharashtra on 15 September, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/14391251/

sentences.text: 1  Court granted interim protection to the applicants approached to it.

::: Uploaded on - 16/09/2022 ::: Downloaded on - 17/09/2022 10:22:08   908-aba-1239-2022.odt  (2)
 4. Perused the FIR.
Except the allegations of selling Gutka  in a hotel, nothing is there against the applicant.
The said Gutka has  been seized by the police in a small quantity.
The issue of  applicability of Section 328 of the Indian Penal Code is seized with  the Hon'ble Supreme Court and interim protection has been granted  to the persons approached to it.
The applicant has a good case for  interim protection.

Hence, the following order :
 ORDER (A) In the event of arrest, the applicant, Ganesh Bhivsen Zende, be released on interim bail till the next date, on executing P.B. and S.B. of Rs.15,000/- (Fifteen Thousand) with one solvent surety in the like amount in Crime No.305 of 2022 registered with Belwandi Police Station, District Ahmednagar for the offence punishable under Sections 328, 273, 188 of the Indian Penal Code r/w Section 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

(S.G. MEHARE, J.) Mujaheed//
